name: Planar Reflection-Aware NeRF
definition: A NeRF variant that jointly models planar reflectors (e.g., windows) and explicitly casts reflected rays to capture the source of high-frequency reflections, preventing the creation of false geometry along the primary ray.
summary: Planar Reflection-Aware NeRF is a novel view synthesis method that explicitly casts reflected rays and uses edge regularization to capture high-frequency reflections without creating false geometry.
